capabilities: Plot notes as map markers from coordinate properties or formulas
Filter markers by date with a timeline view and grouping modes
Search locations via geocoding or by pasting coordinates and Google Maps links
Style markers with tag-based colors, icons, and priority ordering
Cache downsized thumbnails of location cover images for fast tooltips
extras: Default map tiles require an internet connection; custom tile URLs or vault images can be used instead. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: functions similarly to the official Maps plugin, but is more performant for big vaults
problem: Obsidian's official Maps plugin can be slow in large vaults and offers limited extensibility, thumbnail support, and customization for map views.
